text: Week 73 - Coaching_Jenny_Huda_Wk73_2024-06-29_M_2da22175abdd91fcU_2024-06-28_00-00-00 00:03:30 huda: https://sites.google.com/view/computers4everyone/home 00:11:04 Jenny Duan: https://elementia.submittable.com/submit 00:11:31 Jenny Duan: https://joinreboot.org/ 00:14:41 Jenny Duan: https://joinreboot.org/p/the-liars-dividend 00:19:16 huda: Are you looking to pursue journalism, videography, or business? "Folklift" is the perfect initiative to work with. In our initiative, we interview local small businesses part of minorities & display their work in different mediums whether it's by video, article, or other marketing strategies. For instance, as a Muslim in the Bay Area, I have written articles about small Muslim-owned businesses in the Bay. Our goal is to uplift unheard voices, promote buying local, and developing a creative outlet for people across the nation. In joining our team, you would be in charge of a branch of Folklift in your specific area. For instance, if you lived in LA, your title would be "President of Folklift LA Chapter," or "LA Content Head." In order to apply, please DM me on reddit or our instagram; https://www.instagram.com/folkliftig, please let us know your target small-business, preferred medium, etc. To find out more, visit our website: netlify.folklift.app 00:29:33 huda: Hi! I'm Huda, a hs senior and aspiring journalist. I noticed you were part of the 2023 cohort for JCamp, and I am part of the cohort this year! I was wondering if you'd be open to have a call in the coming weeks to discuss your experience with JCamp and journalism as a whole. Thank you!
